payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count 1s and 0s in A and B; construct strings with 1s/0s left-aligned, then swap bits to avoid both-1/both-0 collisions, maximizing high-order XOR bits.
payload.rationale: The core logic uses bit counting and greedy rearrangement to maximize XOR, a classic bit_xor_trick for shuffled-bit maximization.
